mapper.select: SELECT p.pz_num AS configNum,t.byte_sum AS totalNum,t.reject_sum AS blockNum,t.monitor_sum AS monitorNum,t.drop_conn_sum AS discardedNum,t.loop_conn_sum AS refluxNum FROM ( SELECT COUNT(0) pz_num FROM ui_cfg_num_statistics WHERE cfg_state = 1 ) p, ( SELECT SUM(c2s_byte_len + s2c_byte_len) AS byte_sum,sum(reject_num) AS reject_sum,sum(monitor_num) AS monitor_sum,sum(drop_conn_num) AS drop_conn_sum,sum(loop_conn_num) AS loop_conn_sum FROM NTC_TOTAL_REPORT WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} ) t

SELECT #{push} AS time,a.app_name AS name,t.link_sum AS num FROM (SELECT app_type,MAX(link_num) AS link_sum FROM TRAFFIC_APP_STATISTIC WHERE stat_time>= #{start} AND stat_time<#{end} GROUP BY app_type) t , ui_code_app_dic a WHERE t.app_type=a.view_code

SELECT MAX(s.time) AS time,r.request_title AS letterNo,r.request_number AS topic,COUNT(s.compile_id) AS num FROM ui_request_info r RIGHT JOIN ( SELECT t.request_id,t.service_id,t.compile_id,MAX(t.statistic_time) AS time FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) s ON r.id = s.request_id WHERE r.is_valid = 1 GROUP BY letterNo,topic

SELECT #{start} AS time,task.audit_time AS taskTime,task.task_name AS taskName,COUNT(lwhh.id) AS letterNum, COALESCE(SUM(num.cfg_num),0) AS configNum, COALESCE( SUM(num.reject_sum),0) AS monitorNum, COALESCE( sum(num.monit_sum),0) AS controlNum FROM ( SELECT * FROM ui_task_info WHERE is_valid=1) task LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM ui_request_info WHERE is_valid=1 ) lwhh ON task.id = lwhh.task_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT req.request_id,COUNT(req.compile_id) AS cfg_num, SUM(pz.reject_sum) reject_sum, SUM(pz.monit_sum) monit_sum FROM ( SELECT t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) req LEFT JOIN ( SELECT s.cfg_id, SUM(s.reject_sum) reject_sum, SUM(s.monit_sum) monit_sum FROM ( SELECT p.cfg_id,( CASE WHEN (p.service BETWEEN 16 AND 40) OR (p.service BETWEEN 258 AND 273) OR (p.service =576) THEN p.sum ELSE 0 END ) AS reject_sum, ( CASE WHEN ( (p.service BETWEEN 128 AND 152) OR (p.service BETWEEN 384 AND 513) OR (p.service BETWEEN 848 AND 1030) OR (p.service = 592) OR (p.service = 1152)) THEN p.sum ELSE 0 END ) AS monit_sum FROM ( SELECT t.cfg_id, t.service, t.sum, t.report_time FROM ntc_pz_report t) p ) s GROUP BY s.cfg_id ) pz ON pz.cfg_id = req.compile_id GROUP BY req.request_id ) num ON lwhh.id = num.request_id GROUP BY taskName,taskTime HAVING (letterNum + configNum + monitorNum+controlNum > 0);

SELECT #{end} AS time,t.website AS name,COALESCE(SUM(s.link_sum),0) AS num FROM (SELECT t.id,w.website FROM ui_website_domain_topic t LEFT JOIN (SELECT item_code webid,item_value website FROM ui_sys_data_dictionary_item WHERE type=1 AND dictionary_id=111 ) w ON w.webid = t.website_service_id ) t RIGHT JOIN (SELECT web_id,SUM(link_num) AS link_sum FROM TRAFFIC_HTTP_STATISTIC WHERE web_id>0 GROUP BY web_id ) s ON s.web_id = t.id GROUP BY t.website HAVING name is not null ORDER BY num desc LIMIT 10;
SELECT pid AS audioId,SUM(num) AS num,MAX(LOG_URI) AS url FROM MM_AUDIO_REPORT WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} GROUP BY audioId ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT pid AS vedioId,SUM(num) AS num,MAX(LOG_URI) AS url FROM MM_VIDEO_REPORT WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} GROUP BY vedioId ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT pid AS imageId,SUM(num) AS num,MAX(LOG_URI) AS url FROM MM_PIC_REPORT WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} GROUP BY imageId ORDER BY num DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT account AS phonenum,SUM(num) AS num,MAX(LOG_URI) AS url FROM MM_VOIP_REPORT WHERE report_time >= #{start} AND report_time < #{end} GROUP BY phonenum ORDER BY num desc LIMIT 10

SELECT task.audit_time time, task.task_name event, sum(case t.service_id when 128 then t.sum else 0 end) as ipNum , sum(case t.service_id when 129 then t.sum else 0 end) as httpNum , sum(case t.service_id when 132 then t.sum else 0 end) as mailNum , sum(case t.service_id when 390 then t.sum else 0 end) as vedioNum , sum(case t.service_id when 592 then t.sum else 0 end) as agentNum FROM (select * from ui_task_info where is_valid=1) task LEFT JOIN (select * from ui_request_info where is_valid=1) lwhh ON task.id = lwhh.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.request_id,r.service_id,COALESCE(SUM(t.sum),0) AS sum FROM ( SELECT t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) r , ( SELECT cfg_id, service, sum(sum) AS sum FROM ntc_pz_report WHERE service IN (128, 129, 132, 390, 592) GROUP BY service, cfg_id )t WHERE t.cfg_id = r.compile_id GROUP BY r.request_id,r.service_id ) t ON t.request_id=lwhh.id GROUP BY event,time HAVING (ipNum+httpNum+mailNum+vedioNum+agentNum)>0;

SELECT task.audit_time time, task.task_name event, sum(case t.service_id when 16 then t.sum else 0 end) as ipNum , sum(case t.service_id when 17 then t.sum else 0 end) as httpNum , sum(case t.service_id when 20 then t.sum else 0 end) as mailNum , sum(case t.service_id when 262 then t.sum else 0 end) as vedioNum , sum(case t.service_id when 576 then t.sum else 0 end) as agentNum FROM (select * from ui_task_info where is_valid=1) task LEFT JOIN (select * from ui_request_info where is_valid=1) lwhh ON task.id = lwhh.task_id LEFT JOIN (SELECT r.request_id,r.service_id,COALESCE(SUM(t.sum),0) sum FROM ( SELECT t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id FROM ui_request_num_statistics t GROUP BY t.request_id, t.service_id, t.compile_id ) r , ( SELECT cfg_id, service, sum(sum) sum FROM ntc_pz_report WHERE service IN (16, 17, 20, 262, 576) GROUP BY service, cfg_id ) t WHERE t.cfg_id = r.compile_id GROUP BY r.request_id,r.service_id) t ON t.request_id=lwhh.id GROUP BY event,time HAVING (ipNum+httpNum+mailNum+vedioNum+agentNum)>0;
